# Env vars read outside src/flujo that MAPA.md does not document yet.
#
# Why a pin and not a hard gate: test_toda_variable_de_entorno_esta_documentada
# scanned ONLY src/flujo, so every variable read in cultura/ and tools/ escaped
# the documentation rule entirely -- and cultura/ is where the Hub, Research and
# Codex actually live. Widening the scan found this many at once, and a gate that
# cannot pass gets disabled instead of obeyed.
#
# So the rule is a ratchet: this list may only SHRINK. A NEW variable read
# outside src/flujo must be documented in MAPA.md section 4 or the gate fails.
# Documenting one and deleting its line here is the way forward; the count is the
# measure of the debt, not a target to protect.
#
# Regenerate deliberately with:
#   python3 tools/env_baseline.py --write
